description: Test suite for category management in the focalboard server application, including create, update, delete, move, reorder, and verification of categories.

methods.name: TestCreateCategory
methods.description: Tests creation of categories, including valid creation and various invalid input scenarios.

methods.name: TestUpdateCategory
methods.description: Tests updating categories, including valid updates, invalid updates, and permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestDeleteCategory
methods.description: Tests deletion of categories, including normal deletion, already deleted, and system category restrictions.

methods.name: TestMoveBoardsToDefaultCategory
methods.description: Tests moving user boards to a default category, handling existing default category and creation if needed.

methods.name: TestReorderCategories
methods.description: Tests reordering categories, ensuring all categories are included and order is correctly applied.

methods.name: TestVerifyNewCategoriesMatchExisting
methods.description: Verifies that new category lists match existing categories, checking for count and identity.
